# employment role

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:employmentRole`](gmeow-employmentRole.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/employmentRole>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/employment`](../../slices/employment.md)

The role borne by this employment — a job title, position, or function. Functional: an employment has one canonical role at a time; a change of role is a new employment record or a standpoint-indexed claim. Specializes [`gmeow:hasRole`](gmeow-hasRole.md).
